in_marathi.name: Arubhi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Rudra's wish fulfilled
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arubhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arubhi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arodhana’ which means ‘raising up’ or ‘uplifting’. The name is also associated with the goddess Rudra, who is the god of primal energy. Arubhi is believed to be the fulfillment of Rudra's wish. This name is blessed with spiritual strength, courage, and the power to overcome challenges.
